name: Legendary Leader
body:
You’re well known for something you’ve done. This reputation has only served to enhance your capability as a leader.

Prerequisites: Leadership

Benefit: Choose one attribute other than Charisma. From now on this attribute modifier is added to your Leadership score in addition to the normal modifiers and your Charisma modifiers.

Normal: You calculate your Leadership score using your Charisma attribute.
